snippets.name: Weather theme
snippets.description: Drop a place in operand 1. Reads the current weather there (Open-Meteo) and themes the Studio windows to match: sunny, cloudy, fog, rain shimmer, snow, storm flashes; night dims it, wind speeds it up.

snippets.name: Forecast theme
snippets.description: Drop a place in operand 1. Plays the next 8 hours of forecast (Open-Meteo) as a theme that moves to the next hour every cycle.

snippets.name: Mars weather theme
snippets.description: Themes the Studio windows from Curiosity's latest sol in Gale crater (NASA REMS feed): rust to butterscotch with the temperature, a blue Martian sunset at twilight, drifting dust in storm season.
